headline: Kylian Mbappe Returns To France Squad Under Coach Zinedine Zidane
seoTitle: Mbappe Returns To France Squad For Nations League
metaDescription: Coach Zinedine Zidane has included Kylian Mbappe in the latest France squad, featuring a first-time call-up for Pablo Pagis for upcoming matches.
aiSummaryBullets: Kylian Mbappe has been selected for the upcoming France squad following his recovery from a September injury.
The national team manager Zinedine Zidane has included Pablo Pagis, marking the player's first-ever call-up.
France is scheduled to face Italy and Turkey in their upcoming Nations League fixtures.
aiContextParagraph: French national football team manager Zinedine Zidane has finalized the squad roster for upcoming UEFA Nations League competitions. The announcement confirms the return of Kylian Mbappe, who was previously sidelined due to an injury sustained during international play in September. Additionally, the selection introduces Pablo Pagis to the senior national team for the first time. The team is preparing for high-profile matches against Italy and Turkey as part of their Nations League campaign. These roster decisions reflect the current strategic approach of the coaching staff as they navigate injuries and squad rotation. The inclusion of new talent alongside established players highlights ongoing efforts to strengthen the squad's depth ahead of these competitive international fixtures, which serve as a critical component of the broader European football tournament framework.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to the high profile of the returning athlete and the announcement of a new national team player, appearing across multiple sports outlets.
